result:
**Verdict: PASS.** No new finding. F-DG4-148 is accepted as an observation. The acceptance takes effect only when the release-auditor concurs in its own sidecar.

**Candidate and scope**
- I recomputed the candidate on a complete clone at `8553323` and on the working tree, at the start and at the end: `sha256:8014e5ce…` with 1475 files both times.
- The working tree's HEAD is `78fe975`, the freeze commit on top of `8553323`. It adds only the round-8 assignments, the manifest and `stages.json`.
- The diff from round 7's `dab4562` has 0 files outside `docs/delivery/`, so the product code, tests and contract are unchanged. The register is unchanged too.
- The assignment's list of what changed leaves out the round-7 review material committed since `dab4562`. All of it is under `docs/delivery/`, so it doesn't affect the product.

**F-DG4-148 (Low, not mandatory) inside the load envelope**
- I ran `pnpm test` 8 times before any other heavy work: two series covering Node 22 and 24, each with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8. The load was sampled every 15 s, 116 samples in all.
- The 1-minute load stayed between 0.68 and 6.01. No sample went above 8, and no gap between samples was longer than 16 s.
- All 8 runs exited 0. Each ran 1589 + 1347 + 259 tests, plus 2 skips that are by design.
- The two kinds of failure in the finding had a wide margin:

| Test | Time in these runs | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| `architecture.test.ts` | 10–13 s | 30 s |
| RAID "action register" first render | 1.1–1.9 s | 5 s |

**Judgement on D-133, D-134 and the envelope text**
- D-133 and D-134 match the round-7 records and the user's decision.
- The envelope is accurate and enough to work with. Every recorded failure happened at a load of 12.4 or more. Every run at a load of 9 or less passed: in round 6, round 7 and now 8 of 8. Three wording slips have no behavioural effect, so I recorded them as observations, not findings:
  - The "pre-freeze runs passed at load 1.4–2.3" figure comes from load readings taken when the e2e runs started and ended (rounds 3–7). No reading was taken during `pnpm test`, and rounds 1–2 recorded none.
  - The failing round-7 run had a load of 12.4–17.7, not "13–16".
  - The text doesn't say outright that a failure inside the envelope is a real failure, though calling it a "valid gate check" implies it.

**Other checks run this round**
- Static checks: 7 of 7 exited 0 (build, typecheck, lint, openapi:lint 652 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast).
- Validator: all five passed (`--historical` for DG3, DG2 and DG1, `--register DG4`, `--pipeline`).
- Register: all 137 assigned requirements match the register's DG4 rows and are IMPLEMENTED, and none of their 1150 evidence paths is missing.

**Not re-run this round**
As the assignment directs, I cited my round-7 results on the identical code for integration, `tests/qa`, REQ-DLV-036, e2e and the axe / 390 px / 200 % / read-only (AUD) probes. Every non-pass in those logs is explained in the record.

**Things to know (none is a finding)**
- Every unit log has 14 React "two children with the same key" warnings in tests that pass. They come from test fixtures that reuse ids, and the same 14 appear in rounds 6 and 7.
- My first launch of the unit series ran no tests because of a bug in my script's arguments. I fixed it and re-ran the series.
- The build gives Vite's usual "chunks larger than 500 kB" warning, which isn't an error.

I didn't decide any product gate (G1–G6), and product G6 never implies DG7. The disposable clone has been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/` (paths relative to it):
- reviews/DG4/round-8/qa-verifier.json
- reviews/DG4/round-8/qa-verifier.verifications.json
- reviews/DG4/round-8/qa-verifier.md
- test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-8/
